about:
Solar Edge Pros was founded in 2005 in San Antonio, Texas, and has since grown into a local solar installation company serving residential and commercial property owners across the state. The business remains privately held, with no founders named in public materials, and operates from a showroom on West Nakoma Street.

The company provides turnkey solar energy systems, including rooftop arrays, ground‑mount installations, solar carports, panel maintenance, standby generators, and battery backup systems. All work is performed in‑house by employees who hold at least an apprenticeship electrician certification, and a master electrician with more than ten years of solar experience oversees every project. A NABCEP‑certified engineer inspects each roof before and after installation, and every job carries a 30‑year workmanship warranty. To date, the firm has completed over 5,000 installations.

Solar Edge Pros serves homeowners and commercial clients in Texas, helping them navigate permitting, utility interconnection, and net‑metering enrollment. The company also supports community initiatives, such as donating solar systems to veterans’ organizations and participating in local food drives.

The firm emphasizes transparency — no hidden fees, no high‑pressure sales tactics, and a single point of contact from quote to completion. Its differentiators include zero subcontractors, bilingual (English/Spanish) staff, and a commitment to “Solar Done Right” through direct oversight and long‑term warranty coverage.
